title: Record one degree-4 sign n=8 parity prefix at 23/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Records one nested triangular prefix for the n=8 symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/16, 1/16, -1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`. This is the degree-4 sign left open by #4816. No new κ. The selected record stays `60403/20000000`.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. Every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest proper prefix is `23/16`. The right shear alone is `2553/2048`, below `5/4`. The next four proper prefixes are `5/4`, and the next five are `21/16`. The even child is `(1, 1/16, -1/16, 1/16)`. Its grandchild's left shear carries `-1/16` and still lifts `5/4` to `21/16`. The quotient is `(1/8, 7/128, 137/2048, 1767/32768)`. The completed product matches the reordered Toeplitz matrix and has infinity norm `3/2`.

This package branches from main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. It does not replay an unmerged predecessor.
